competitors.name: Nestlé USA / DiGiorno / Tombstone / Vital Pursuit
competitors.action: Nestlé said it is doubling down on frozen meals and pizza as a core U.S. growth engine, with two higher-protein Vital Pursuit pizzas launching next month and leadership explicitly framing frozen as a strategically important business. The sharper pizza signal is that the DiGiorno and Tombstone owner says it already controls just under a third of the U.S. frozen pizza market and is still pushing new format and nutrition-led innovation.

competitors.name: Palermo Villa
competitors.action: Palermo Villa was reported to be using a new $100 million facility to push into the fast-growing wood-fired frozen pizza segment. That matters because it suggests a scaled incumbent is not just adding capacity, but using new manufacturing investment to chase a more premium, restaurant-adjacent subcategory where crust/process cues matter more.

competitors.name: Katie’s Pizza & Pasta
competitors.action: Katie’s expanded its Target footprint with new pasta bake entrées and sauces, extending a restaurant-origin frozen pizza brand into adjacent CPG categories at mass retail. Even though this is not a new pizza SKU, it is a meaningful competitive signal: once a premium frozen pizza brand earns Target placement, the next move is often broader freezer-and-pantry shelf capture.

trends.topic: Scaled frozen pizza players are competing on premiumization through process, nutrition, and adjacency rather than only flavor launches
trends.magnitude: Nestlé is adding protein-forward pizzas, Palermo is using new capacity to target wood-fired premium pizza, and Katie’s is widening from frozen pizza into adjacent mass-retail CPG shelves.
trends.context: The useful takeaway for Real Dough is that the premium freezer fight is broadening. Winning brands are pairing a strong product story with either operational scale, health-forward claims, or the ability to expand into adjacent categories once retail trust is earned.

market_data.value: Nestlé says DiGiorno and Tombstone together control just under one-third of the U.S. frozen pizza market
market_data.change: Nestlé is also launching two new Vital Pursuit pizzas next month with 33g protein and 17g fiber each

market_data.value: $100 million new facility tied to expansion into wood-fired frozen pizza

breaking.headline: The freezer aisle is getting more competitive from both ends: scaled incumbents are pushing premium formats harder while restaurant-origin brands widen into adjacent CPG shelves once mass retail opens up.
breaking.impact: For Real Dough, the implication is pretty direct: protect the sourdough/process differentiation, but also keep building a retailer-ready platform that can support adjacent extensions later instead of treating pizza as the only shelf outcome.
